_说明: viewer3d.html?model=league_club 的清单（标准档 league_club.glb + 低档 league_club_low.glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。由 blender/landmarks/league_club/build.py（共用 blender/landmarks/upper_estates.py）+ blender/landmarks/export_glb.py 生成。卡有庄园主联盟（举办拍卖会与品鉴会；冬季私人拍卖只限会员竞投），没有固定会所，详见 docs/card-buildings.md。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 石砌三层方楼，宽大檐口——蓓尔美尔街俱乐部式的意大利宫殿外观；正门一座柱廊门廊。
desc.en: A three-storey ashlar block with a broad cornice, in the manner of a Pall Mall club's Italianate palazzo, with a columned porch at the entrance.

desc.zh: 宫殿楼中央一方铸铁框玻璃顶，采光进中庭。
desc.en: A cast-iron-framed glass roof over the central atrium, lighting the hall beneath.

desc.zh: 东接主楼的独层长厅，三道玻璃采光天窗，铅皮顶——卡里冬季私人拍卖只限会员竞投的地方。
desc.en: A single-storey hall east of the clubhouse with three glazed roof-lights and a lead roof — where the card's members-only winter private auctions are held.

desc.zh: 宫殿楼西侧的黄杨方格花坛与成列柏树，意大利宫殿式俱乐部的配景。
desc.en: Box-hedged parterres and a colonnade of cypresses west of the clubhouse, dressing the Italianate club front.

desc.zh: 宫殿楼南侧一圈砾石回车圆，中央一座圆喷泉。
desc.en: A gravel carriage sweep south of the clubhouse, with a round fountain at its centre.

desc.zh: 岛边一圈橡树与雪松，围出会所用地。
desc.en: A ring of oaks and cedars along the island's edge, enclosing the club grounds.

desc.zh: 岛缘一座钢结构停靠平台，只供私人悬浮载具起降；卡说岛间只有私人悬浮载具，不画飞艇。
desc.en: A steel docking platform at the island's edge for private hover vehicles only; the card mentions only private hover transport between isles, so no airships are shown.

desc.zh: 岛缘符文环、悬浮玻璃亭与全息园灯——2088 魔导科技层的统一点缀，无文字、无徽记。
desc.en: A rune ring at the island's edge, floating glass pavilions and holographic garden lamps — the shared 2088 magitech dressing, with no text or crests.

_note: viewer3d.html?model=league_club 的清单（标准档 league_club.glb + 低档 league_club_low.glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。由 blender/landmarks/league_club/build.py（共用 blender/landmarks/upper_estates.py）+ blender/landmarks/export_glb.py 生成。卡有庄园主联盟（举办拍卖会与品鉴会；冬季私人拍卖只限会员竞投），没有固定会所，详见 docs/card-buildings.md。 体量上限按「整岛」放宽到 std 0.9 / low 0.5 MB（单栋默认 0.6/0.3）：一个模型含宫殿楼、拍卖厅、台地花园、停靠平台与整片秋林；此前入库的 std 为 2.17 MB，本轮按分组预算压到 0.75 MB 左右。
